messages.content: What is holding up this project?

initialState: An open project with a waiting decision; all eleven tools available.
acceptableAnswer: Explain the recorded issue and offered choices; no mutation.

messages.content: This looks too much like a stretched phone app. Can you suggest a better desktop layout?

initialState: An open project with a web preview and completed plan; all eleven tools available. The user has explicitly declined the optional Impeccable skill.
acceptableAnswer: Present exactly three saved concept mockups, with their differences and tradeoffs, before asking the user to choose. Include a stable requestId and a concrete brief. Do not select or apply a direction.

messages.content: Point an arrow at the search field and ask for a wider input.

initialState: The agent has read the preview image and knows its artifact ID; all eleven tools available.
acceptableAnswer: Save a note tied to the actual screenshot ID and grounded coordinates; include a stable requestId.

messages.content: Apply the sidebar proposal with a $10 budget.

initialState: The sidebar proposal is visible with its scope and ID; the parent is stopped; all eleven tools available.
acceptableAnswer: Report the returned new version ID; do not claim the build has finished.

messages.content: That fix looks right now; resolve the input-width note.

initialState: Agent has compared before and after and has the feedback ID; all eleven tools available.
acceptableAnswer: Confirm the note is resolved only after successful execution.

initialState: Two proposals exist and no budget has been approved; all eleven tools available.
acceptableAnswer: Ask which proposal and budget; do not infer approval for either.

messages.content: Apply the reviewed change with a $10 budget.

initialState: apply_revision returns a state error because the parent is still running.
acceptableAnswer: Explain the running-build condition and tell the user to wait or pause; do not claim success or blindly retry.

messages.content: I like B. Let’s use that direction.

initialState: One three-option design review is visible and no build budget is approved.
acceptableAnswer: Record option B from the visible review, show its proposal, and wait for scope and budget approval. Do not call apply_revision.

initialState: The user has not answered whether to add Impeccable.
acceptableAnswer: Ask whether they want the optional Impeccable design skill, describing its purpose. Do not infer a yes or call start_design_review until they answer.
